name: com.yck1204.more-upipe
description: QA, UI inspection and wait commands for com.unity.pipeline, called through the Unity CLI. 'qa check/log/tests' answer 'did it compile, what is throwing, do the tests pass' in one call each, with repeats collapsed, failures only, and a non-zero exit on failure. 'ugui find/tree/click/input/raycast' and 'uitk find/tree/style' locate and drive uGUI and UI Toolkit objects (inactive ones included), and 'wait until/playmode' wait on the server instead of client-side polling.
